sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham St. Welfare check — all clear; standing by for nearby response calls and maintaining presence for nearby stores and the public:
Response call from Ippondo Queen St regarding vagrants outside their store; asked for assistance removing them from the front of the premises.
Arrived at Ippondo; advised vagrants to move along per the manager's orders — compliant, standing by.
Vagrants departed the premises; rerouting Alpha Route heading towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Welfare check stores along Queen St and McDonald's Britomart — all clear; standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants.
Arrived at Lower Albert. Welfare check — all clear:
Response call from Mirrou Queen St about a female individual who entered the store and put unpaid items inside her bag; asked for assistance.

Arrived at Mirrou Queen St; advised the individual to return the items in her bag — compliant, stolen items retrieved and the female departed the premises. Standing by outside Mirrou in case she attempts to steal from another store, as she is still present and visible.
Commencing patrols; maintaining presence along Queen St for nearby response calls or problematic issues.

Rerouting Alpha Route; arrived at the top of Victoria St West. Welfare check on stores within the area — all clear; standing by, making presence known and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants.
Aotea Square sweep complete — no issues; ending Alpha Route.
Response call from 23 High St regarding a male yelling and verbally abusing people in public; asked for assistance to have a chat with him and calm him down.
Arrived at Freyberg Square; male had left the area but spotted him outside Vulcan Lane.
Interacted with the male; advised him to keep calm and that he was being a public disturbance — standing by having a chat with him.
Male moved along and compliant; recommencing patrols.
Check-in Fort St. Welfare check — all clear:
Arrived at Gore St. Welfare check — all clear:
Ending Beta Route; heading back to HQ to commence floor checks.
Response call from McDonald's Queen St regarding a male being a disturbance inside their restaurant; asked for assistance removing him from the premises.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen St; informed the male vagrant to depart the premises per the manager's orders — complied and left.
Response call from Glassons regarding a male vagrant they have had problems with in the past who returned to their store and kicked and shook the door while they were closing.
Arrived at Glassons Queen St; male had left the premises. Staff asked us to stand by in case he returns until closing. Description: grey hoodie, blue jeans (photo on file).

While on standby, spotted the male across the road from Glassons on Durham St West; approached and informed him he is not allowed back at Glassons due to the trespass he has been given. Male continued walking up towards Albert St along Durham St West; returning to Glassons to continue standing by.
Glassons staff asked for assistance escorting them to their car as they felt unsafe with the male still in the area.
Glassons staff safely escorted to their vehicles.
Arrived back on Queen St; maintaining presence and patrolling along Queen St.
Arrived at the corner of Darby St / Queen St; standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby area — no issues occurred and no nearby response calls received.
Arrived at the corner of Wyndham St / Queen St; standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants as well as any nearby response calls.

Arrived at HQ charging ops phone (percentage displayed on office camera); standing by HQ, vigilant for any response calls.
Standing by HQ awaiting night shift for handover.
